en: Hello {manager}, the cost code {name} has used {used} of its budget: {actual} of {budget}. The forecast for the year is {forecast}. Check: {state}. Please tell me the reason and what we can change.
mt: 您好,成本代码 {name} 使用了 {used} 的预算: {actual} 的 {budget}. 预测为今年是 {forecast}. 检查: {state}. 请告诉我原因和我们可以改变什么.

en: Hello {owner}, {name} ({crop}, {area_ha} ha) shows a profit of {profit} this year, that is {per_ha} per hectare. Check: {state}. Please send me the reasons: yield, price or costs.
mt: 您好, {owner}, {name} ({crop}, {area_ha} ha) 显示今年的利为 {profit},即每公的 {per_ha}. 检查: {state}. 请给我原因:收益率,价格或成本.

en: Hello, the payment {item} of {amount} is due on {due}. Status: {state}. Please prepare the payment and keep the receipt.
mt: 你好, {item} 的付款是 {due}. 状态: {state}. 请准备付款并保留收据.

en: Hello, the licence payment {item} for {authority} is due on {due}. Please renew it on time and send me the receipt.
mt: 您好,请按时续约,并给我收据.

en: Hello, please send a statement for loan {loan_id}. Our records show a balance of {balance} and the next payment on {next_due}. Tell us if you see a difference.
mt: 您好,请发送贷款的声明. 我们的记录显示, {balance} 的余额和下一次付款在 {next_due}. 如果你看到差异,告诉我们.

en: Hello {officer}, please find our application documents for {scheme} attached. We apply for {applied}. Please confirm that you received everything.
mt: 你好,请找到我们的申请文件. 我们申请了. 请确认您收到了一切.

en: Hello {officer}, we send the evidence for the payment claim on {scheme}. The evidence date is {evidence_due} and the amount still to come is {outstanding}. Please confirm receipt.
mt: 你好,我们在1日发送支付索赔的证据. 证明日期是2日,还有待支付的金额是3日. 请确认收据.

en: Hello {inspector}, we confirm your inspection on {date}: {scope}. Please tell us which maps, invoices and photos you want to see.
mt: 你好,我们确认您的检查:请告诉我们您想要看到哪些地图,发票和照片.

en: Hello, we report a {event} on {field} on {event_date} under policy {policy}. We claim {claimed}. Please send the claim form and arrange an assessor.
mt: 您好,我们在政策下报告了 {event} 在 {field} 在 {event_date} 我们声称 {claimed}. 请发送索赔表格并安排评估员.

en: Hello, we send photos and evidence for claim {claim_id} ({event}, {field}). The status is {status} and it has been open for {days_open} days. Please tell us if you need more.
mt: 您好,我们发送照片和证据. 状态是 {status},它已经开放了 {days_open} 天. 请告诉我们如果你需要更多.

en: Hello {inspector}, we confirm the {kind} on {date}. Scope: {scope}. Please tell us which records you need and we will have them ready.
mt: 请告诉我们你需要哪些记录,我们会准备好.

en: Hello {inspector}, here is our reply on the {kind} of {date}: {actions_open} actions are open and due on {action_due}. Please confirm that the plan is accepted.
mt: 您好,这是我们在 {kind} 的 {date} 上的回答: {actions_open} 行动已开放,截止于 {action_due}. 请确认计划已被接受.

en: Budget against actual report of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
mt: 预算与日期为 {set:firm} 的实际报告相比.

en: Cost code: {col:budget.code} {col:budget.name}. Group: {col:budget.group}. Budget holder: {col:budget.manager}.
mt: 费用代码: {col:budget.code} {col:budget.name}.

en: The budget holder explains any difference and proposes action before the next monthly close. The budget was last reviewed on {col:budget.reviewed}.
mt: 预算持有者解释任何差异,并建议在下一个月结束前采取行动.

en: Profit per field report of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
mt: 截至1日的 {set:firm} 的实地报告中,每场利

en: Loan summary of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
mt: 贷款总结日期为 {set:firm}

en: Lender: {col:loans.lender}. Loan: {col:loans.loan_id}, {col:loans.type}. Purpose: {col:loans.purpose}.
mt: 贷款人: 贷款人: 贷款人:

en: The loan is secured by: {col:loans.collateral}. The interest for the coming year on the balance is about {col:loans.interest_year}.
mt: 这笔贷款的担保是: {col:loans.collateral}.

en: Grant application summary of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
mt: 补助申请摘要,日期为 {set:firm}

en: Certification and compliance register of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
mt: 认证和合规性登记簿,日期为 {set:firm}

en: Certificate or permit: {col:certs.name}. Kind: {col:certs.kind}. Issued by: {col:certs.body}.
mt: 证书或许可证: {col:certs.name}. 类型: {col:certs.kind}.

en: Year-end farm report of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
mt: 年终农场报告日期为 {set:firm}

en: Current assets were {col:ratios.current_assets} against current liabilities of {col:ratios.current_liabilities}, a current ratio of {col:ratios.current_ratio}. The quarter check shows: {col:ratios.state}.
mt: 流动资产为 {col:ratios.current_assets} 与流动负债为 {col:ratios.current_liabilities},流动比例为 {col:ratios.current_ratio}.
